Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class VisionOutput.VisionOutputStruct

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.VisionOutput.VisionOutputStruct
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.struct.Struct<VisionOutput>
Enclosing class:
VisionOutput
public static class VisionOutput.VisionOutputStruct extends Object implements edu.wpi.first.util.struct.Struct<VisionOutput>
WPILib Struct implementation that (de)serializes a VisionOutput to/from raw bytes. The targetsIds, targetsPoses and cameraToTargetsTransforms arrays are packed/unpacked with a fixed capacity of 3 entries, padded with sentinel values (-1 for ids, -999 coordinates for poses/transforms) when fewer targets are present.
